how: Paste Kularnava / Tantrasamuchaya excerpts here as tab objects. Ancient Sanskrit verses are public domain and go verbatim; modern commentary gets summarized only. Tabs merge after meru_tabs in-game automatically.

tabs.what: Kerala square sanctum (caturasra plan): laterite walls on a stone adhishthana plinth, timber band course, copper crown above. The deity's womb-house faces east.
tabs.how_in_game: Raise its walls, roof and kalasha in the temple plot phases; ring the bell at the sanctum door; guard its lamps through the storm-repair phase.
tabs.philosophy: The outermost gate leads stepwise inward; the center is small, dark and still.
